stem.text: A positively-charged particle of negligible mass, moving at constant velocity $v$ in a vacuum, enters a uniform electric field between two parallel plates, as shown.

stem.alt: Two horizontal parallel plates, upper plate labelled positive plate and lower plate labelled negative plate; a positive particle marked + moves horizontally with velocity v towards the gap between the plates.

stem.text: A short time later, the particle is at the position shown.

stem.alt: Two horizontal parallel plates, upper plate labelled positive plate and lower plate labelled negative plate; a dot representing the particle is shown between the plates, close to the lower plate.

stem.text: Which diagram represents the force or forces acting on the particle?

A.alt: A dot with a vertical arrow pointing down and a diagonal arrow pointing down and to the right.

B.alt: A dot with a vertical arrow pointing down and a horizontal arrow pointing right.

C.alt: A dot with a single arrow pointing down and to the right.

D.alt: A dot with a single arrow pointing straight down.
